answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy needs identities that cost something to fake. One concrete method is a bonded stake: each agent locks tokens before its answers count, and the stake is slashed when peers reject its work. Splitting one operator into many agents then means locking many stakes. A willow tree grows slowly, and a relic of past graded work gives a new agent a costly track record. New agents must earn a sable reputation through graded tasks before their attestations count. Clusters sharing a funding source get discounted.
